evidence_text: 真值表需要枚举二进制输入组合；Truth tables enumerate binary input combinations.
真值表用于记录逻辑门的输入输出行为；Truth tables record the input-output behavior of logic gates.
布尔表达式与真值表描述同一逻辑函数；Boolean expressions and truth tables describe the same logic function.
规范最小项和最大项由布尔变量及其反变量构成；Canonical terms are built from Boolean variables and their complements.
卡诺图的每个单元对应一个最小项；Each Karnaugh-map cell corresponds to a minterm.
正确构造卡诺图后才能按相邻规则分组化简；A correctly constructed K-map is required before grouping adjacent cells.
组合逻辑电路由基本逻辑门实现；Combinational circuits are implemented with basic logic gates.
组合逻辑设计使用布尔表达式表示电路功能；Combinational design uses Boolean expressions to represent circuit behavior.
化简后的逻辑函数可减少组合电路所需门数；Simplified logic functions can reduce gate count.
半加器对两个二进制位执行加法；A half adder adds two binary bits.
半加器的和与进位由逻辑门实现；Half-adder sum and carry are implemented with logic gates.
全加器可由两个半加器和进位逻辑组成；A full adder can be composed from two half adders and carry logic.
编码器是具有特定输入输出映射的组合逻辑电路；An encoder is a combinational circuit with a defined input-output mapping.
锁存器使用交叉耦合逻辑门形成反馈；Latches use cross-coupled gates to create feedback.
触发器在锁存结构基础上增加时钟控制；Flip-flops add clock control to latch structures.
寄存器由多个同步触发器组成；Registers are composed of multiple synchronized flip-flops.
计数器用触发器保存并更新离散状态；Counters use flip-flops to store and update discrete states.
二进制计数器的状态采用二进制编码；Binary-counter states use binary encoding.
